metaDescription: Order custom recyclable lanyards for your business. Eco-friendly, durable, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom recyclable lanyards let you promote your brand while supporting sustainability goals. Made from materials that can be processed in standard recycling streams, these lanyards are a practical choice for trade shows, employee IDs, and event credentials. The 3/4" width offers a comfortable fit, and sublimation printing delivers vibrant, all-over color that won't fade. Choose recyclable lanyards when you need a durable, eco-conscious solution that aligns with your company's environmental commitments.
heroAltText: Stack of custom recyclable lanyards with full-color sublimation printing, ideal for events and employee IDs
